figma.notes: Local SVGs ready. Re-upload via MCP when rate limit resets.

dimensionPolicy: UI strip below image only. SVG must never imply that the full drawing width equals the typed opening.

semantics.customerWidthMm: Clear opening between posts ONLY (what the customer types).
semantics.totalRunMm: clearOpeningMm + tailMm — parking-side clear run required.
semantics.silhouetteSeed: Exports use 4000×1000 so <desc> carries the worked example; proportions are schematic 1/3, not a live measurement ruler.
drawingCues: Leaf fills 100% of clear opening between brick posts
Triangular counterbalance AFTER the right/guide post (outside opening) — LOCKED from linea guida + renders
Continuous bottom box/rack through leaf into tail
Guide rollers / upper guide cues on parking post
Carriage + foundation under tail only — dashed clearance under opening (no driveway track)
No baked dimension arrows on the silhouette

notSeparateSilhouettes: exact tail mm (always ratio cue on drawing; live number in UI)
doNotMislead: Do not draw the triangle inside the clear opening between posts.
Do not label the full CAD width (leaf+tail) as the customer opening.
Do not show a solid ground track across the driveway opening.
Show opening + min tail + total run in the UI strip below — not as rulers on the drawing.
Composite 3-bay is leaf cladding only — tail stays structural triangle.

lookup.description: First matching rule wins. Topology always includes counterbalance tail (~1/3 schematic).
